knowledge_sources.source: Advances in Financial Machine Learning - Marcos López de Prado
Probabilistic Machine Learning for Finance and Investing

instructions.instruction: Validate candidate strategies against rigorous multiple-testing corrections.

Deflated Sharpe Ratio (DSR): - Compute Expected Maximum Sharpe under the null hypothesis given number of search trials (n_trials). - Compute Probabilistic Sharpe Ratio (PSR) adjusted for non-Gaussian skewness and kurtosis. - Mark strategy as PASSED only if DSR >= 0.95 (95% confidence that edge is genuine).
Account for friction: Deduct 0.05% exchange taker fee and 0.02% slippage on every trade.
